This error likely resulted from erroneously prioritizing partial or misinterpreted information, such as misreading the years or failing to validate the comparative analysis. The mistake fits the pattern of "Inconsistent Chronology" as described in the error examples, where the agent misinterprets or miscalculates chronological data.
